Hi Phil, 


I have a dataset of about 6500 participants and 860 items. On average, each participant completes 30 items. 

Hence, you see the red boxes in the image. I designed the data collection such that each item bank has about 8-10 overlapping items with another. So the items have shared information throughout.  

The items are assumed to be unidimensional, so I would like to conduct concurrent calibration. 

I tried running a Rasch (works), and a 2PL (didn't work - iteration over 2000). 

I am just trying to figure out what is the best next step from here. 

Would you say the best approach is to instead use the multipleGroup()? 


Kind regards,

Aiden
